installCommand: export PNPM_HOME=$PWD/.pnpm SHELL=/bin/bash && npx --yes get-pnpm 12.0.0 && $PNPM_HOME/bin/pnpm install --filter=examples-agent... --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: cd ../.. && PATH=$PWD/apps/factory/.pnpm/bin:$PATH npm exec --yes --package=turbo@$(head -n 1 version.txt) -- turbo run build --filter={apps/factory}...
